text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with<n>Mejiro
Dober...

Urgh... I can't give up looking yet!<n>Hang in there a
little longer, quads!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure that was Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober! Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Ryan and some friends<n>were invited to
a neighborhood<n>concert as guest performers, but
someone had to drop out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The concert's this evening, but I<n>can't find a
replacement!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! I<n>haven't even said
anything yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Goodness... You saw right through<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ryan? Can you teach me the<n>songs and
choreography?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ryan? Can you teach me the<n>songs and
choreography?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What?! Does that mean you're<n>willing to be our
replacement<n>member?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That'd be great, but... you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It won't be easy, but...

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Star light, star bright, I wish to become<n>a big, strong
racer who can win any<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you take it one step at a<n>time, you'll
move closer to not only<n>me... but also the racer you
want to<n>become.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to keep moving forward.<n>And just like I
promised myself when<n>I was little...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best not to be a burden!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, you'd never be a<n>burden! You're the
best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Dober. And thanks to your<n>trainer too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And now for the final pose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That was good! I'm glad the outfit is<n>the right size
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... It looks like we'll beready for the performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-huh.
...Yeah. I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Next up is what you've all been<n>waiting for! Our
special guest<n>performance for the night!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I almost gave up on my childhood<n>dream because I
thought I could<n>never make it happen, but...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to reach for it once more...<n>with Trainer,
this time!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! That was awesome, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there will be fireworks<n>after the
performance. They're about<n>to start.
choice_data_list: You did great during the concert.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.
choice_data_list: You were so bold and confident out there.
Aren't you going to join the after-party?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I really feel like I<n>accomplished
something.
choice_data_list: You were so bold and confident out there.
Aren't you going to join the after-party?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-you're just saying that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-you did?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Still, if my passion really did come<n>across and
everyone was able to see<n>how much I've
changed...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If my passion really did come across<n>and everyone
was able to see how<n>much I've changed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Then I'm glad I mustered up the<n>courage to
perform.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then... I'm glad I mustered up the<n>courage to
perform.

look even more beautiful<n>than the ones I saw as a
child.

text_block_list.text: ...Well, I was the one who decided to<n>perform.

text_block_list.text:
And I could never embarrass myself<n>in front of a
crowd or my da—ahem,<n>my friends.
choice_data_list: I'm sure he's always watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I can't embarrass myself in front<n>of an
audience... or my dad.
choice_data_list: I'm sure he's always watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's not like I need him to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I hope he is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But, maybe if he saw that, he'd<n>realize he doesn't
have to be so<n>overprotective anymore.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just want to watch the<n>fireworks with
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So... What did you think of the<n>concert?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober

text_block_list.text: I want to keep improving and becomeeven more radiant. No, I don't justwant to—I'll make it happen.

Fireworks light up the sky as she<n>makes her vow,
and I make my own<n>to support her as best I can to
